picks.file: Gezicht op de haven van Bari aan de zuidkant Vue du port de Bari, du côté du Midi (titel op object) Voyage en Italie, en Sicile et à Malte - 1778 (serietitel), RP-T-00-492-59B.jpg
picks.what: The town from the harbor on the south side, watercolor (Rijksmuseum)
picks.why: color; walls, domes and bell tower of the old town behind beached boats; dated 1778 travel album; color chart and sheet margins cut

picks.file: Veduta di Bari, capoluogo della provincia.jpg
picks.what: The town from the harbor, engraving
picks.why: general waterfront view with domes and the tall bell tower; 67 years after the 1778 view; caption and plate number cut

picks.file: Panorama del Porto Nuovo di Bari (xilografia).jpg
picks.what: The old town and the new harbor, wood engraving in Le Cento Città d’Italia
picks.why: high bird’s-eye view over the flat roofs of the old town to the harbor moles and ships; sharper and clearer than #8

picks.file: Photo View of the eastern side of the city of Bari taken from the bell tower of the Cathedral 1936 - Touring Club Italiano s05986-01.jpg
picks.what: The eastern side of the city from the cathedral bell tower, photograph (Touring Club Italiano)
picks.why: dated general view over the old town roofs, the domes and the waterfront; mount edges cut

gaps: P0, P1, P2: no candidates. P6: nothing usable (two railway station platforms; #15–#18 are places called Bari in India).
notes: The 1778 Rijksmuseum album ‘Voyage en Italie, en Sicile et à Malte’ is usually credited to Louis Ducros (the Commons record names only the Rijksmuseum). P3 alternative: #2, the same album’s view of the town point from the inn window with the cathedral bell tower (gray wash, not as wide). #8 (1888, Molo Vecchio) is the same series as #7 and also fine. Skipped #10 and #12 (single buildings) and #3, #5, #6 (harbor and shipyard scenes with little of the town).
